description: This file defines the interface for a low-level multi-channel inter-processor mailbox communication API in Zephyr OS, including data structures, macros, callback types, and function prototypes for mailbox operations.

methods.name: mbox_init_channel
methods.description: Initializes an mbox_channel struct with a device pointer and channel ID.

methods.name: mbox_send
methods.description: Attempts to send a message over a specified mailbox channel.

methods.name: mbox_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for incoming messages on a mailbox channel.

methods.name: mbox_mtu_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum data size that can be sent over a mailbox device.

methods.name: mbox_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables interrupts and callbacks for a mailbox channel.

methods.name: mbox_max_channels_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of channels supported by the mailbox hardware.
